title: Perturbation theory and the onset of chaos
summary: Canonical perturbation theory and small denominators; time-dependent perturbations; fixed points, stability and bifurcations; the damped driven pendulum, Poincaré sections and sensitive dependence; the KAM picture and the logistic map.
